title: Stalin to Elmo in four real photos
description: Four real photos connect Joseph Stalin to Elmo from Sesame Street, through Churchill, the Queen and a first lady.
hook: How is Joseph Stalin connected to Elmo?

image.file: File:Yalta summit 1945 with Churchill, Roosevelt, Stalin.jpg

links.line: In 1945, Joseph Stalin sat beside Winston Churchill at Yalta to plan the end of World War Two.
In February 1953, Prime Minister Churchill greeted the new Queen, Elizabeth the Second, and her children.
In May 2007, on a state visit to America, the Queen toured a Washington children's hospital with Laura Bush.

image.file: File:Mrs. Laura Bush and daughters pose for a photo with Sesame Street character Elmo.jpg

links.line: And that same month, Laura Bush posed with Elmo at a Sesame Street benefit dinner in New York.
